- Standing bounce-class checks: every checklist item ticked with evidence; SpecDoc production call path has a passing Atlas test
- Call-site Integration: Atlas.Parser.SpecDoc is the production caller of the two stable parse_file/2 functions; proving tests are the existing Atlas SpecDoc tests passing on the PR.

Out of Scope (files):
- /Users/mz/src/ancora/** (except a README text fix if the stable-API section is wrong, via its own ticket)
- any other consumer repo
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- Atlas: mix.exs, mix.lock, .spec/**, .claude/**, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Makefile, make/worktree.mk, docker-compose.yml, lib/atlas/parser/spec_doc.ex and its tests, CI config if it names retired flags

Out of Scope (intent):
- no vendoring of the parser; the retarget is the stability commitment
- never config-off a code without an ADR line; never edit spec text to dodge a finding
- a perf miss is the on-disk-cache re-entry decision, not tuning in this PR

Merge gate:
- [ ] Atlas CI green including the shim new path
- [ ] Bench medians under budget, recorded on the ticket
- [ ] Checklist items 1-12 checked in the PR description
- [ ] Migration ADR merged with the PR
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
